plan.problem: The installed dormant verifier accepts repository-associated MEMBER/COLLABORATOR identities, which is broader than the Yumaniwa Owner authority model intended for initial authenticated manual attestation.
plan.currentContract: The base registry pending transition preauthorizes tools/change-verification-check.cjs from blob 7f54001a813dd89fa65018b780a18c25a7141b0b to exact owner-only blob c3d748b5a2329e428c38c327883613c98b19bf61.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: GitHub author_association indicates relationship, not Yumaniwa Owner authority. Before any live workflow exists, the verifier itself must reject every identity except the trusted repository owner for this user-owned repository.
plan.design: Install the exact preauthorized verifier blob. It requires event.repository.owner to be a GitHub User with valid login/id and requires comment.user and event.sender to match that owner by both login and immutable numeric ID. author_association remains evidence only. Return registry to steady, update tests/docs, and keep the verifier dormant.
alternativesRejected: Allow all write/admin collaborators; repository access is not equivalent to Yumaniwa Owner Decision authority.
Use author_association as authorization; MEMBER/COLLABORATOR is too broad.
Use mutable username-only authorization; numeric user ID must also bind identity.
Install the live workflow in the same package; workflow trust and artifact delivery require separate review and exact-blob authorization.
plan.migration: After merge, staging returns to steady with owner-only verifier blob c3d748b5a2329e428c38c327883613c98b19bf61 as the contracted expected blob. No live human evidence exists yet.
plan.compatibility: Existing Verification Record v0.2 behavior and C3-2 evidence remain unchanged. The attest subcommand remains dormant and becomes stricter only for future use.
boundaryCases: Repository owner must be a GitHub User with valid login and numeric ID.
Owner login mismatch is rejected even if author_association says OWNER.
Owner numeric ID mismatch is rejected even if login matches.
author_association NONE is not itself a rejection when trusted owner identity matches.
Organization owner type is rejected by the initial user-owner-only contract.
Fork PR, non-default base, stale SHA, bot, sender mismatch, malformed check set, and source blob mismatch remain rejected.
